lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Bay doors open. You're clear to drop.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Clamps released. Go and find our people.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: This one's the planet of the day. The corps pays half again for anyone you bring home from here.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: New world. Deep canyons, thin air, and beacons down in the cracks. Stay low and mind the walls.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Forest world. Trees the size of towers, and a canopy you can't see through. Our people are in the clearings.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: There's a dead city down there. Nobody's home. Except our pilots, in the streets and on the roofs.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Ice world. Crevasses, white-outs, and cold enough to crack a hull. When the snow comes in, trust your radar.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Volcanic world. Lava down in the valleys, ash in the air. Our people are up on the cooled shelves. Do not touch the lava.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Crystal forest down there. Spires as tall as towers. The big ones will stop you dead. The small ones break.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Ocean world. Islands, sea stacks, arches. Our pilots are on the islands. Skim the water if you like. Just don't dive into it.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Volcanic below. Keep your height over the lava.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Crystal forest below. Mind the spires.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Open sea below. Stay off the water.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Beacon on your scope. That's one of ours.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Another beacon. Bring them home.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Cabin's full. Climb to dock height and we'll take it from there.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: That's everyone down there. Climb up and come home.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: I have you. Hold steady, bringing you in.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Docking clearance granted. Easy does it.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Clamps on. Welcome home.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: You're in. Get them to the infirmary.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: You're out of power. Tow beam's on its way. That's going on your bill.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Recall received. We're coming to get you. It isn't free.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: That's the last of them. Planet's clear. Good work down there.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Jump drive spooling. Hold on to something.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Welcome back. Again.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Welcome back. Try to keep this body in one piece.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: You're awake. Good. Take a minute. Then get back out there.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Cut your engines. They won't come near a hot ship.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Watch your energy. I can't tow everyone.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: That was no pilot. Good call.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: You just burned one of ours. That comes out of your pay.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Security's dealt with your passenger. Don't ask.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: I've lost your signal. Regeneration bay, stand by.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Heads up, this one's hot. Gun turrets on the high ground. Keep low and they can't see you.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Heads up, this one's hot. Turrets on the high ground, and saucers in the air. Stay low, keep moving.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: New distress calls coming in from a planet you'd cleared. More of ours went down there. It's on the star map.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Workshop says she's ready. Try not to bend it.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: There's a crashed drone down there with its flight recorder still in one piece. It's on your scope. Land beside it, engines off, and winch it aboard.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Command wants a turret nest cleared out of one of the valleys. It's marked on your scope. Worth the trouble.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: One of ours is on failing life support. The clock's on your scope. Get them aboard and home before it runs out.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Bonus on this one if you clear the planet without a scratch on the hull.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Recorder's aboard. Bring it home.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: That's the nest gone. Nice shooting.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Their life signs just went flat. We were too late for that one.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: That's a scratch on the hull. So much for the clean run.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Side job's logged. The corps pays its debts.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Your old ship's still down there. It's on your scope. Land beside it, cut your engines, and hook it up.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Salvage line's on. She'll be back in the bay when you dock.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Movement near the wreck. You're not alone down there.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Insurance is logged for this flight. Try not to make them pay out.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Welcome to training, pilot. Practice planet, practice ship. Nothing you do out here goes on your record.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Let's get a feel for her. Pitch, roll, yaw, throttle. Then let go of the stick and watch her level herself.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Your radar shows every beacon and how far out it is. Pick a target, follow the trail, and keep an eye on where home is.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Time to put her down. Brake into landing mode, find the ring, and settle in nice and slow.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Engines off and wait. The pilot runs to you and knocks. Then you open the airlock.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Careful with this one. Watch it, listen to it. That is not a pilot. Keep the airlock shut and light your engines.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: It's on your canopy. Engines or shield. Burn it off before it gets in.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Turret and a saucer, both ours to practise on. Guns hot. Shield up when they fire back.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Your power's running low. Climb for the mothership, or hold recall and we'll come and get you.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: If the view drifts, look straight ahead and recentre it.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: That's it. Next.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Take your time. The step's on your display, with the button for it.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: Lesson complete. Well flown.

lines.speaker: Control
lines.text: That's the lot. You're ready for the real thing.

lines.speaker: Computer
lines.text: Energy low.

lines.speaker: Computer
lines.text: Return now.

lines.speaker: Computer
lines.text: Mothership out of reach.

lines.speaker: Computer
lines.text: Pull up.

lines.speaker: Computer
lines.text: Hull damage.

lines.speaker: Computer
lines.text: Hull critical.

lines.speaker: Computer
lines.text: Landing gear down.

lines.speaker: Computer
lines.text: Airlock open.

lines.speaker: Computer
lines.text: Pilot aboard.

lines.speaker: Computer
lines.text: Cabin full.

lines.speaker: Computer
lines.text: Intruder alert. Intruder alert.

lines.speaker: Computer
lines.text: Engines off.

lines.speaker: Computer
lines.text: Visibility low. Instruments only.

lines.speaker: Computer
lines.text: Hull heat. Climb.

lines.speaker: Computer
lines.text: Warning. Locked on.

lines.speaker: Computer
lines.text: Saucer. Saucer.

lines.speaker: Computer
lines.text: Shield up.

lines.speaker: Computer
lines.text: Shield down.

lines.speaker: Computer
lines.text: Target destroyed.

lines.text: Mayday, this is Hale. I'm down on the ice. It's cold. It's so cold. Come get me.

lines.speaker: Hale
lines.text: Mayday, this is Hale. I'm on a ledge over the lava. It's getting hot. Please hurry.

lines.speaker: Hale

lines.speaker: Hale
lines.text: Mayday, this is Hale. I'm down on an island. Water everywhere. Is anyone up there?

lines.speaker: Hale
lines.text: Mayday, mayday, this is... this is Corps pilot Hale. I'm down, I'm down. Beacon's on. Is anyone... up there?

lines.speaker: Hale
lines.text: I see you! I see you! I'm coming!

lines.speaker: Hale
lines.text: That's you! Hold on, I'm on my way!

lines.speaker: Hale
lines.text: It's me! Open up!

lines.speaker: Hale
lines.text: Open the hatch! Please, open it!

lines.speaker: Hale
lines.text: It's me. It's me. Open... open up.

lines.speaker: Hale
lines.text: Oh, thank you. Thank you. I thought nobody was coming.

lines.speaker: Hale
lines.text: You're a sight for sore eyes. Thanks for the lift.

lines.speaker: Hale
lines.text: How long till we dock?

lines.speaker: Hale
lines.text: I'm never going back down there. Never.

lines.speaker: Hale
lines.text: Does anyone else hear that?

lines.speaker: Hale
lines.text: No! No, get away from me! Get it off!
